chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to identify and select relevant details when reading for a specific purpose.
Students will be able to extract specific factual information from a text of approximately 400–500 words.
Students will be able to interpret text headings to anticipate the specific information required for brief notes.
Students will be able to formulate concise notes that align closely with the wording of the original text.
Students will be able to construct note-based answers that include both a relevant noun and verb.
Students will be able to complete a set of brief notes by selecting the appropriate details from a passage.
Students will be able to recognize paraphrased text to locate answers that are not explicitly phrased like the prompt.
Students will be able to apply spatial constraints by keeping written responses within specified line limits.
